title: Deep Validation with Pydantic v2
summary: Field constraints, validators, special types, model config, and partial updates.

sections.content: Use Field() to add constraints to model fields. Common constraints: gt (greater than), ge (>=), lt, le, min_length, max_length, pattern (regex), max_digits, decimal_places, multiple_of.

from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Item(BaseModel):
    name: str
    description: str | None = Field(default=None, title="The description", max_length=300)
    price: float = Field(gt=0, description="Price must be > 0")
    tax: float | None = None
    tags: list[str] = []

from datetime import datetime, date
from uuid import UUID
from pydantic import BaseModel, HttpUrl, EmailStr, SecretStr

class User(BaseModel):
    id: UUID
    email: EmailStr                 # needs pip install email-validator
    signup_ts: datetime | None
    birth_date: date | None
    website: HttpUrl | None         # validated URL
    password: SecretStr             # never printed in repr/logs
Use @model_validator for whole-model checks that span multiple fields:

from pydantic import BaseModel, ConfigDict

class Item(BaseModel):
    model_config = ConfigDict(
        extra="forbid",          # reject unknown fields (default: 'ignore')
        str_strip_whitespace=True,
        validate_default=True,
        populate_by_name=True,   # allow field names in addition to aliases
    )
    name: str = Field(alias="itemName")

sections.title: Production tip
sections.content: extra='forbid' is a great production default — clients get 422 for typos instead of silently dropping data.
exclude_unset=True only includes fields actually provided in the request — the standard pattern for PATCH operations.

code_challenge.title: User Registration with Validators
code_challenge.description: Create a POST /register endpoint with a User model: username (alphanumeric), email (EmailStr), password (min 8 chars), and a password2 field that must match password.
hints: The validators handle the validation — FastAPI returns 422 automatically

quiz.question: How do you constrain a field to be greater than 0?
quiz.explanation: Use Field(gt=0) to add the greater-than constraint. FastAPI/Pydantic validates automatically and returns 422 on violation.

quiz.question: What does extra='forbid' in model_config do?
quiz.explanation: extra='forbid' rejects any fields not defined in the model. This catches client typos. The default in Pydantic v2 is 'ignore'.

quiz.question: What does model_dump(exclude_unset=True) do?
options: Only includes fields the client actually sent
quiz.explanation: exclude_unset=True only includes fields that were explicitly provided in the request data — essential for PATCH operations.

quiz.question: Which decorator validates a single field?
quiz.explanation: @field_validator validates a single field. @model_validator validates the whole model (multiple fields together).

quiz.question: What type safely hides sensitive data in repr/logs?
quiz.explanation: SecretStr prevents the value from being displayed in repr or logs. Access the value with .get_secret_value().
